principle: An authoritative event may exist without being known to every character or exposed in every operational record.
rules: authoritative_internal is not automatically player-visible or NPC-visible.
Participants may know an event occurred without knowing every referenced payload detail.
Witness knowledge requires plausible presence, perception or an explicit information channel.
Formal reports may expose a curated subset rather than the full authoritative event.
Academy instructors may receive events for supervised exercises when the session grants that authority.
Service records are derived curated records; they do not mirror every operational event.
NPC memory must be produced through a valid knowledge path, not by reading the entire event store.
Classified, private, medical or otherwise restricted data may require additional domain-specific access rules.
Visibility changes do not mutate the original operational fact; they change who may retrieve or know it.

projection_examples.example: Cadet begins a sensor scan in a supervised simulator.
Sensor officer reports two unidentified contacts to command.
A raw sensor result is created.
projection_examples.note: The result itself remains governed by the sensor result record and ship knowledge rules.
